newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold volume plunges, prices rise.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold volume plunges, prices rise.

text.p: Istanbul gold volume tumbled to 285 kg on Monday from Friday's 898 kg in extremely quiet trade due to holiday in the U.S. markets, dealers said.
Prices rose in line with the higher levels in European markets, helped by a weak Turkish lira in domestic markets.
Gold closed at $380.30 an ounce and 1,201,500 lira per gram, up from $378.55 and 1,193,800 lira on Friday.
The lira ended at 98,100 against the dollar, down from Friday's 97,620 close. Currency trade was also subdued because of the U.S. holiday.
Volume was 225 kg in the morning and only 60 kg in the second session. Ninety-three percent of the total daily turnover was in lira terms.
